summary: Navan, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its bankruptcy-remote, wholly owned subsidiary Navan Travel US SPV LLC entered into a $225 million revolving warehouse credit facility on October 5, 2026, agented by Barclays Bank PLC. The facility funds purchases of the company's corporate charge card receivables, which serve as first-priority collateral; a 24-month revolving period is followed by a three-month amortization, with borrowing-base limits and SOFR/conduit-based pricing plus a 1.40% Class A margin. No advances were outstanding at filing. This is a routine receivables financing, not a special situation; watch collateral performance and SPV isolation.
